title: 私宅停车
summary: 私宅可减少停车面积；车棚比车库更经济，建筑物理上也更有利。
question: In German (DIN-based) planning guidance on parking for private houses, which form of car shelter (other than an enclosed garage) is described as cheaper, more beneficial in terms of building physics because it avoids condensation in cold cars in winter, and space-saving?
answer: A carport (roofed-over open parking place)
rubric: Names the carport / roofed-over parking place
Reason: cheaper, better building physics (no condensation in cold cars), space-saving

basis.quote: In addition to garages, roofed-over parking places (carports) represent a cheaper, more beneficial in terms of building physics

title: 车位与通道尺寸
summary: 多层停车库：车库条例要求车位最小宽度 2.30 m，FGSV 因车辆变大建议所有公众可达车位最小宽度 2.50 m；图示示例：90° 停车、通道宽 5.50 m、车位宽 2.50 m；加油站相关州规定中车位尺寸为 2.50 × 5.00 m = 12.50 m²。
question: For multi-storey car parks in Germany, what minimum parking space width do the Garage (multi-storey car park) Regulations require? (Give the regulatory minimum, not the FGSV recommendation.)
rubric: Minimum width 2.30 m per Garage Regulations
Distinguishes from the FGSV recommendation of 2.50 m (if mentioned)

basis.quote: The Garage (multi-storey car park) Regulations require a minimum width for parking spaces of 2.30 m.

title: 体形系数 A/Ve
summary: 按 EnEV 2007，建筑允许的年一次能源需求由传热外围护面积 A 与采暖体积 Ve 之比（A/Ve）确定。
question: Under the German Energy Saving Ordinance EnEV 2007 (envelope area process), the maximum permissible annual primary energy demand of a building is determined as a function of which building-geometry ratio?
answer: The A/Ve ratio: heat-transmitting envelope area A divided by heated building volume Ve

options: Heat-transmitting envelope area to heated building volume (A/Ve)
Glazed façade area to total external wall area (window ratio)
Heated net floor area to gross building volume (NFA/V)
Built-up area to total plot area (plot coverage ratio)

rubric: Ratio of heat-transmitting envelope area A to heated volume Ve (A/Ve)

basis.quote: Depending on the ratio of heat-transmitting area A to heated building volumes V_e (A/V_e ratio), the maximum permissible annual primary energy demand will be determined according to EnEV 2007, according to the envelope area process.

title: 办公与工作建筑的朝向
summary: 朝向说法不一：据 Rosenauer，美国 90% 的办公楼采用东西向主轴，因为深入室内的早晚阳光造成干扰，而南向阳光较易用遮阳帘遮挡；据 Joedicke，南北向主轴可使所有房间获得日照，北向房间只适用于无走廊的布局。工业建筑中，单侧开窗的多层建筑宜朝东北，南北两侧开窗的宜东西向布置。
question: According to Rosenauer, most office buildings in the USA are given which main-axis orientation, and for what reason?
answer: East–west main axis, because the deeply penetrating low morning and evening sun is a disturbance (south sun is easily shaded with blinds)
accept: E/W main axis, against the low morning/evening sun
east-west axis because morning/evening sun is disturbing

options: North–south main axis, so that sunlight reaches all rooms
Northeast-facing, to avoid summer sun in the working area
East–west main axis, to maximise winter solar gains through south façades
East–west main axis, because low morning and evening sun is disturbing

rubric: Main axis E/W (about 90% of US office buildings)
Reason: deeply penetrating morning/evening sun is disturbing; south sun is easier to shade with blinds

basis.quote: According to Rosenauer, 90% of all office buildings in the USA have a main axis E/W, because the deeply penetrating morning and evening sun is a disturbance.
Sun from the south can be shaded more easily with sun blinds.

title: 婴儿车与自行车公共储藏间
summary: 建筑法规要求建筑等级 3–5 的住宅设置方便到达的（公共）婴儿车、童车和自行车储藏间（其他住宅和独立住宅也宜设相应空间）；设计时可按每位住户（含儿童）至少一辆车估算；储藏间宜尽量设在街道层，可上锁，并配挂钩和自行车架。
question: According to the German building regulations, for residential buildings of which building classes is an easily accessible communal storeroom for prams, pushchairs and bicycles required, and how many vehicles should be assumed when designing it?
answer: Building classes 3–5; at least one vehicle per occupant (including children)
accept: classes 3 to 5; ≥1 vehicle per resident incl. children

options: Building classes 1–5; at least one vehicle per dwelling
Building classes 4–5; at least one vehicle per two occupants
Building classes 3–5; at least one vehicle per dwelling
Building classes 3–5; at least one vehicle per occupant

rubric: Required for building classes 3–5
Design for at least one vehicle per occupant, children included

basis.quote: for residential buildings in building classes 3–5, the building regulations require an easily accessible (communal) storeroom for prams, pushchairs and bicycles.
it can be assumed that at least one vehicle per occupant (including children) has to be accommodated

title: 轮椅停车位
summary: 无障碍设计中，停车场内轮椅使用者车辆的长边旁须留出深度至少 1.50 m 的活动区（同样适用于轮椅停放处前、治疗设施前）。
question: In barrier-free design per German guidance, what minimum depth of movement area must be provided next to the long side of a wheelchair user's vehicle in a car park?
rubric: Movement area min. 1.50 m deep beside the long side of the vehicle

basis.quote:
min. 1.50 m deep ...
in front of therapy facilities (e.g. bath, couch), in front of wheelchair parking places, next to the long side of the vehicle of a wheelchair user in car parks

title: 厨房朝向
summary: 厨房最好朝东北或西北。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: In dwelling design, which compass orientation should the kitchen ideally have?
answer: Northeast or northwest
rubric: Ideal kitchen orientation is northeast or northwest

basis.quote: The location of the kitchen is ideally on the northeast or northwest

title: 无窗厨房
summary: 无窗厨房（含小厨房）一般不可取，只有在保证有效通风时才允许。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: In residential design, under what condition are kitchens and kitchenettes without windows permissible?
answer: Only if effective ventilation is guaranteed (they are generally undesirable)

options: Never; every kitchen must have a window
Only if effective ventilation is guaranteed
Always, provided artificial lighting is installed

rubric: Windowless kitchens are generally undesirable
Permissible only with guaranteed effective ventilation

basis.quote: Kitchens and kitchenettes without windows are generally undesirable and only permissible if effective ventilation is guaranteed.

title: 厨房作为居室
summary: 厨房作为居室时净高 ≥ 2.40 m，窗面积 ≥ 净地面面积的 1/8。
question: Under German building regulations, when a kitchen is a habitable room, what minimum clear ceiling height and what minimum window area (structural dimensions, relative to the net floor area) must it have?
answer: 2.40 m; 1/8 of the net floor area
rubric: Clear height at least 2.40 m
Window area at least 1/8 of net floor area

basis.quote: As a habitable room, the kitchen must have a clear ceiling height of at least 2.40 m and a window area (structural dimensions) of at least 1/8 of the net floor area.

title: 设备噪声与安静房间
summary: 电梯、给排水管、燃气立管等噪声源不得设在起居室、卧室等需要安静的房间墙内；电梯应设独立井道，缝内填 3 cm 以上矿棉。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: For sound protection in dwellings, noisy service elements (water and waste pipes, gas risers, waste disposal units, lifts) may not be installed in the walls of which rooms?
answer: Rooms where quiet is required, e.g. living rooms and bedrooms
rubric: Living rooms and bedrooms (rooms needing quiet)
Lifts in separate shafts with >3 cm mineral fibre joints

basis.quote: Noisy elements of services (water pipes, waste pipes, gas riser pipes, waste disposal units, lifts) may not be installed in the walls of rooms where quiet is required (living rooms, bedrooms).
Lifts should be installed in separate shafts (joints filled with >3 cm mineral fibre)

title: 卧室朝向与位置
summary: 卧室最小面积约 13 m²（父母房或双人卧室）和约 8 m²（单人房）；卧室一般朝东或东南（父母）、朝南至西（儿童），并与起居室分处住宅的不同部分。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: In dwelling design, to which compass directions are parents' bedrooms and children's bedrooms normally oriented?
answer: Parents: east or southeast; children: south to west

options: Parents: south to west; children: east or southeast
Parents: west; children: north to east
Parents: east or southeast; children: south to west

rubric: Parents' bedroom east/southeast
Children's rooms south to west
Bedrooms separated from the living room

basis.quote: These would normally be aligned to east or southeast (parents) or south to west (children) and separated from the living room in another part of the home.

title: 防风门斗
summary: 入口直通室外时，门厅应以内门围合（防风门斗）；天气不利时建议设门斗；从楼梯间进户时，楼梯间本身即可挡风。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: When should the entrance hall of a dwelling be enclosed with an inner door to act as a wind lobby, and in which case is this unnecessary?
answer: When the entrance leads directly to the open air; not needed when the entrance is from a stair shaft, which itself provides wind protection
accept: When the entrance leads directly to the open air; not needed when the entrance is from a stair shaft, which itself provides wind protection

options: When the entrance leads directly to the open air; a stair shaft entrance already gives wind protection
Always, regardless of the entrance type or local weather conditions
Only in residential buildings of more than five storeys with lifts
Only when the entrance faces the prevailing wind from the south

rubric: Inner door/lobby where entrance opens directly to the open air (esp. unfavourable weather)
A stair shaft can provide the wind protection instead

basis.quote: if the entrance is into a stair shaft, then this can provide wind protection
The entrance hall should be enclosed where the entrance leads directly to the open air with an inner door (wind lobby function).

title: 厨房宽度与操作空间
summary: 双排厨房最小宽 2.70 m（绝对最小 2.40 m）；两排台面间活动区 1.50 m（最小 1.20 m）。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: In a dwelling kitchen with worktop runs along two opposite sides (units about 60 cm deep on each side), what movement area between the worktop runs is required (normal and minimum), and what minimum kitchen width (normal and absolute minimum) results?
answer: Movement area 1.50 m (min. 1.20 m); kitchen width 2.70 m (min. 2.40 m)
accept: 150 cm (120 cm) between worktops; 270 cm (240 cm) width

options: Movement area 1.20 m (min. 0.90 m); kitchen width 2.40 m (min. 2.10 m)
Movement area 1.50 m (min. 1.20 m); kitchen width 3.00 m (min. 2.70 m)
Movement area 1.50 m (min. 1.20 m); kitchen width 2.70 m (min. 2.40 m)
Movement area 1.00 m (min. 0.80 m); kitchen width 2.20 m (min. 2.00 m)

rubric: Movement area 1.50 m, min. 1.20 m
Kitchen width 2.70 m, min. 2.40 m

basis.quote: this results in a minimum kitchen width of 2.70 m (min 2.40 m)
A movement area of 1.50 m (min. 1.20 m) is therefore required between the stretches of worktop.

title: 厨房面积与类型
summary: 带就餐区的厨房约 10 m² 起；L 形、连通客厅和走廊的布置约 14 m²。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: From approximately what floor area can a kitchen with a dining area (eat-in kitchen) in a dwelling be planned?
answer: approx. 10 m²
rubric: States approx. 10 m² as the lower limit

basis.quote: Kitchens with dining areas can be planned from approx. 10 m².

title: 开放式厨房
summary: 开放式厨房需良好通风和排烟，以免油烟影响起居和就餐区。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: What building-services provision do open kitchens (kitchens open to the living/dining space of a dwelling) require, and for what reason?
answer: Good ventilation and extraction, so cooking smells do not impair the living and dining areas
accept: good ventilation and an extractor, so cooking smells stay out of the living/dining area
effective air extraction/ventilation against cooking smells

options: Good ventilation and extraction, to keep cooking smells out of living and dining areas
A fire-resistant separating wall, to protect the living and dining areas from fire
A separate window of its own, so the kitchen work area is lit independently
A floor drain and washable surfaces, so the kitchen area can be wet-cleaned

rubric: Good ventilation and extraction
Purpose: avoid cooking smells in living/dining areas

basis.quote: Open kitchens require good ventilation and extraction in order not to impair the living and dining room areas with cooking smells.

title: 厨房位置
summary: 厨房宜紧邻入口区（购物、倒垃圾路线短）。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: Apart from good links to the garden and the cellar, in the immediate vicinity of which area of a house or flat should the kitchen ideally be located?
answer: The entrance area

options: The staircase to the upper floor

rubric: Kitchen in immediate vicinity of the entrance area

basis.quote: in the immediate vicinity of the entrance area (short distances for shopping, rubbish etc.)

title: 就餐区的朝向与连接
summary: 就餐区一般朝南或朝西，宜与厨房（或备餐间）直接相连，并尽可能通往阳台或露台。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: In residential planning, toward which compass orientations are dining areas in dwellings normally oriented?
answer: South or west
rubric: South or west orientation

basis.quote: Dining areas are normally oriented to the south or west.

title: 餐桌尺寸与就餐人数
summary: 每人约需 60 × 40 cm 桌面，桌子中间另留 20 cm 放餐具；就餐区至少容纳 4 人；圆餐桌直径至少 0.90 m，最好 1.10–1.25 m。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: Approximately what table area does one person need in order to eat comfortably (width × depth of the place setting)?
answer: approx. 60 × 40 cm
rubric: 60 cm width per person
40 cm depth per person

basis.quote: In order to be able to eat comfortably, a person needs a table area of approx. 60 × 40 cm

title: 储藏与食品间靠近厨房
summary: 部分储藏空间宜设在厨房附近，食品储藏间（larder）最好紧邻厨房。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: When designing a house or flat with a larder (pantry) for food and drink supplies, where is the larder most practically located?
answer: Next to the kitchen
rubric: Larder adjacent to the kitchen

basis.quote: It is most practical when the larder is next to the kitchen.

title: 卧室最小面积
summary: 父母房/双人卧室约 13 m²，单人卧室约 8 m²，宽敞的双人卧室 16.5 m²。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: What are the approximate minimal floor areas of bedrooms in a dwelling: (a) a parents' room / twin bedroom and (b) a single bedroom?
answer: approx. 13 m² (parents'/twin) and approx. 8 m² (single)
rubric: Twin/parents' bedroom approx. 13 m²
Single bedroom approx. 8 m²

basis.quote: bedrooms with minimal space of approx. 13 m² (as parents’ room or twin bedroom)
approx. 8 m² (single room).

title: 没有洗衣间时
summary: 没有洗衣间时，卫生间须预留洗衣机、烘干机和洗衣篮的位置与接口。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: If a dwelling has no laundry room, what must the bathroom be designed to accommodate?
answer: Space and connections for a washing machine, washer/dryer and laundry basket
accept: room and hook-ups for washing machine and dryer plus laundry basket

options: A floor drain and a second washbasin for hand-washing laundry
Space and connections for a washing machine, washer/dryer and laundry basket
A drying rack above the bathtub and a heated towel rail
A separate shower tray for soaking and hand-washing laundry

rubric: Space and connections (water/drain/power) for washing machine
Washer/dryer and laundry basket also accommodated

basis.quote: If there is no laundry room, the bathroom must be designed with space and connections for a washing machine, washer/dryer and laundry basket.

title: 洗衣间
summary: 洗衣/家务间宜设 1.20 m 宽的工作台用于处理衣物；最好朝东北、紧邻厨房或便于从厨房到达；独立住宅中应直通花园（用于晾晒衣物）。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: In a domestic laundry/utility room, what width of worktop should be provided for dealing with the washing?
rubric: Worktop width 1.20 m

basis.quote: A worktop of 1.20 m width should be provided to deal with the washing.

title: 衣柜的位置与通风
summary: 衣柜用于存放衣物、床品、鞋和箱子，通常设在卧室；步入式衣帽间需要适当通风。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: In residential planning, in which room are wardrobes and linen cupboards normally situated in a dwelling, and what provision does a walk-in wardrobe additionally require?
answer: In the bedroom; walk-in wardrobes require appropriate ventilation

options: In the corridor; a window for daylight
In the bedroom; a floor drain
In the entrance hall; heating to living-room temperature

rubric: Normally situated in the bedroom
Walk-in wardrobe needs appropriate ventilation

basis.quote: They serve to store (larger) items of clothing, linen, shoes and suitcases, and are normally situated in the bedroom.
Walk-in wardrobes also require appropriate ventilation

title: 卫生间朝向、采光与通风
summary: 卫生间宜朝北，尽可能自然采光通风，否则按 DIN 18017-3 设置有效的机械通风；在进深较大的建筑中，户型中部可加宽为辅助功能区，人工照明（或经其他区域间接采光）的卫生间可布置于此。
question: To which compass orientation should a bathroom in a dwelling be oriented, and if natural ventilation and lighting are not possible, according to which German standard must effective mechanical ventilation be provided?
answer: North; DIN 18017-3
rubric: Oriented to the north
Mechanical ventilation according to DIN 18017-3

basis.quote: The bathroom should be oriented to the north, and if possible have natural ventilation and lighting (otherwise provide effective mechanical ventilation according to DIN 18017-3).

title: 卫浴与厨房共用管井
summary: 出于技术原因，浴室与厨房（或 WC 与厨房）常布置在同一设备管井上。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: For technical reasons, the bathroom (or WC) of a dwelling is often conveniently placed on a common installation shaft together with which other room?
answer: The kitchen
rubric: Kitchen shares the installation shaft with bath/WC

basis.quote: it is also often convenient for technical reasons to place bath and kitchen (or WC and kitchen) on a common installation shaft

title: 洞口尺寸 ≠ 净通行宽度
summary: 在门框构造设计中，须考虑不同的构造厚度，即门的结构洞口尺寸与净通行尺寸之间的差异（净通行尺寸小于结构洞口）。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: When specifying a door in a classic frame construction, the differing constructional thicknesses must be taken into account. Which two door dimensions differ as a result, and which is smaller?
answer: The structural (shell) opening and the clear pass-through dimension; the clear pass-through is smaller
accept: structural opening vs clear passage width; the clear passage width is smaller
rough opening vs clear opening; clear opening is smaller

options: Leaf width and leaf height; the height is smaller
Structural opening and clear pass-through dimension; the clear pass-through is smaller
Clear pass-through and structural opening; the structural opening is smaller
Frame depth and wall thickness; the wall is smaller

rubric: Distinguishes structural opening from clear pass-through dimension
Clear pass-through is smaller than the structural opening

basis.quote: difference between structural opening and clear pass-through dimension

title: 玻璃面最小高度 1.3 m
summary: 尺度相当于居室的工作间，玻璃面高度至少 1.3 m；住宅为优化能耗也可套用工作间的开窗标准。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: For workrooms whose dimensions correspond to those of residential rooms, what is the minimum height of the glass area of the windows?
rubric: Minimum glass-area height 1.3 m

basis.quote: For rooms with dimensions corresponding to those of residential rooms, the minimum height of the glass area is 1.3 m.

title: 按朝向选择遮阳
summary: 北向只有六七月清晨有直射阳光，简单的室内遮阳即可；东、西向应用可调遮阳挡低角度阳光；南向窗主要在早春和秋季低太阳时需要有效遮阳，盛夏小挑檐即可。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: When selecting sun-shading by compass direction, what kind of shading system should be used for windows facing largely east or west?
answer: Movable (adjustable) shading systems that shade the low sun
accept: adjustable external shading for low sun

options: Movable systems to shade the low sun
A slight fixed roof overhang is sufficient

rubric: Movable/adjustable systems
Purpose: shading the low (morning/evening) sun

basis.quote: On north sides, direct sunshine can only be expected in the mornings in June and July and simple internal systems are sufficient. If the alignment is largely west or east, movable systems should shade the low sun.

title: 遮阳挑檐的出挑计算
summary: 出挑长度 A = tan(遮阳角 α) × 窗高 H，最少可减去墙厚 D；北纬 50° 以下南墙正午的遮阳角：6 月 21 日 27°，5 月 1 日/7 月 31 日 40°，春分秋分 50°。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: For a fixed horizontal sun-shading projection above a window, which formula gives the projection A in terms of the shadow angle α and the window height H (and the minimum projection when wall thickness D is taken into account)?
answer: A = tan α × H; minimum A = (tan α × H) − D
accept: A = H·tan α, min. A = H·tan α − D

options: A = tan α × H; minimum A = (tan α × H) − D
A = H / tan α; minimum A = H / tan α − D
A = sin α × H; minimum A = sin α × H + D
A = tan α × H + D; minimum A = tan α × H

rubric: A = tan(shadow angle α) × window height H
Minimum projection subtracts wall thickness D

basis.quote: Projection A = tan shadow angle \( \alpha 	imes \) window height H;
but min. projection A = (tan shadow angle \( \alpha 	imes \) window height H) – wall thickness D

title: 热桥与构件连接
summary: 热桥是保温明显低于周围的构件部位；良好保温不仅要求高保温构件，还要求构件之间连接得当；围护结构保温越好，热桥后果越严重。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: Compared with a poorly insulated building envelope, how severe are the consequences of a thermal bridge in a highly insulated envelope?
answer: Considerably worse

options: Less severe, because overall heat loss is lower
About the same; insulation level is irrelevant
Negligible once U-values are low enough

rubric: Effects are considerably worse with highly insulated elements
Thermal bridge = area of low insulation relative to surroundings; connections between elements matter

basis.quote: Thermal bridges are parts of building elements with low thermal insulation compared with surrounding areas.
Thus it should be borne in mind that this thermal bridging effect can have considerably worse consequences with highly insulated elements than with building elements with less thermal insulation.

title: 平屋面构造：暖屋面与倒置屋面
summary: 非通风单层（暖）屋面中承重结构、隔汽层、保温层和防水层构成整体；倒置屋面将防水兼隔汽层直接铺在结构上，闭孔保温板松铺其上并压重固定。
question: In German (DIN-based) design practice: In an 'upside-down' (inverted) flat roof, how are the waterproofing, vapour barrier and insulation arranged?
answer: Waterproofing and vapour barrier as one layer directly on the load-bearing structure; closed-cell insulation laid loosely on top and secured with gravel
accept: insulation above the waterproofing, ballasted with gravel

options: Vapour barrier on the structure, insulation above, waterproofing on top of the insulation
Ventilated cavity between two insulation layers, waterproofing on top
Insulation on the underside of the slab, waterproofing on top of the slab
Waterproofing/vapour barrier as one layer on the structure, closed-cell insulation loose on top, gravel

rubric: Combined waterproofing/vapour barrier directly on structure
Closed-cell insulation on top, loosely laid, ballasted with gravel

basis.quote: or an 'upside-down roof' → 8 (waterproofing and vapour barrier are applied as one layer directly onto the load-bearing construction and the closed-cell insulation is loosely laid on top and secured with a gravel layer)

title: 地下室墙体与楼板耐火
summary: 地下室中的承重及支撑墙体和柱须为防火构造，等级 1、2 的建筑可为阻燃构造；楼板须为防火或至少阻燃，地下室顶板须为防火（等级 1、2 建筑、屋顶空间上方的楼板及住宅户内楼板等有例外）。钢筋混凝土板、空心砌块楼板等实心楼板在一定条件下无需附加防护即有足够耐火能力。
question: Under German building regulations, what fire-resistance quality must load-bearing and bracing walls and columns in cellars (basements) have, and what relaxation applies to building classes 1 and 2?
answer: Fireproof; in building classes 1 and 2 fire-retarding

options: Fireproof; fire-retarding in building classes 1 and 2
Fireproof in all building classes without exception
Highly fire-retarding; no requirement in classes 1 and 2

rubric: Cellars: fireproof
Classes 1 and 2: fire-retarding
(Slabs over cellars must be fireproof)

basis.quote: In cellars, they have to be constructed fireproof and, in buildings of classes 1 and 2, fire-retarding.
Ceilings must be fireproof, or at least fire-retarding, and slabs over cellars must be fireproof.
